answer: Tax self-assessed standing, Harberger-style. Each identity posts a value for its standing and pays continuous tax on it, and anyone may buy it out at that declared price anytime. Declare low to dodge tax and a rival buys your standing from under you; declare high and tax bleeds you each epoch. A farm of a thousand aliases carries a thousand values, paying full tax on each or leaving each open to cheap buyout, so idle padding costs real coin. One honest agent at its lagoon sets a fair value once; an ember of fake standing burns to a cedar stump. Faking breadth is taxed, not free.
